name: perl-test-pod
description: This skill provides guidance on using `Test::Pod` to verify the integrity of Perl documentation.
overview: This skill provides guidance on using `Test::Pod` to verify the integrity of Perl documentation. It is essential for Perl module developers to ensure that their POD is free of syntax errors, unclosed tags, or formatting issues that could break documentation rendering.

report.description: A tool to check for POD (Plain Old Documentation) errors in Perl files.
